hero.description: Let's reestablish the peer-to-peer nature of Bitcoin! Exchange sats for your local currency directly with other humans. No middlemen, no personal data required.

features.title: Why lnp2pBot?
features.subtitle: Bitcoin is an accessible and equitable savings technology and a censorship-resistant medium of exchange.

items.title: Keep Your Privacy
items.description: lnp2pBot will never ask you for personal data. No KYC, no registration, no identity verification. Your sats, your business.

items.title: Lightning Fast
items.description: Powered by the Lightning Network for instant Bitcoin transactions at minimal cost without losing any of Bitcoin's core properties.

items.title: Find Your Community
items.description: Join an existing community or create your own. Exchange sats for your local currency with people near you.

items.title: True Peer-to-Peer
items.description: Bitcoin was designed for peer-to-peer transactions. lnp2pBot brings that vision to life, connecting buyers and sellers directly.

items.title: Censorship Resistant
items.description: Built on open protocols. No single entity can shut it down, block your transactions, or freeze your funds.

items.title: Open Source
items.description: Fully transparent and community-driven. Anyone can review, contribute, or run their own instance of the bot.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Four simple steps to trade Bitcoin peer-to-peer

steps.title: Open the Bot
steps.description: Start a conversation with @lnp2pBot on Telegram. No registration needed.

steps.title: Create or Take an Order
steps.description: Post a buy or sell order with your preferred amount, currency, and payment method — or take an existing one.

steps.title: Trade P2P
steps.description: The bot escrows the sats via Lightning hold invoices. Send or receive fiat payment, then confirm to release funds.

steps.title: Receive Your Sats
steps.description: Once both parties confirm, the Lightning payment is settled instantly. Done — no intermediaries, no KYC.
